```{=html}
<!-- The portal's opening page when accounts are on: assets/gate.js sends
     visitors who haven't signed in here, and sends signed-in visitors on
     to the app. The sidebar shell is hidden on this page (custom.scss). -->
<div class="tb-landing-wrap">
  <section class="tb-landing-intro">
    <div class="tb-brand">
      <img src="images/logo.svg" alt="" width="40" height="40">
      <span class="tb-brand-text">
        <span class="tb-brand-name">TakwimuBridge</span>
        <span class="tb-brand-sub">Qualitative Data Analysis</span>
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="tb-landing-pitch">
      <span class="tb-landing-kicker"><i class="bi bi-stars"></i> By Sustainable Solutions Tanzania (SST)</span>
      <h1>Turn interviews and focus groups into clear, evidence-backed themes.</h1>
      <p class="tb-landing-lead">Code KIIs, FGDs, in-depth interviews and open-ended responses, and watch theme frequencies, weights and comparisons update as you work.</p>
      <ul class="tb-landing-features">
        <li><i class="bi bi-highlighter"></i><span><strong>Code in one reading.</strong> Run several thematic analyses on the same transcripts, with undo and redo.</span></li>
        <li><i class="bi bi-bar-chart-line"></i><span><strong>Analyse as you go.</strong> Frequencies, weights, a respondent matrix, group comparisons and theme clouds.</span></li>
        <li><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-down"></i><span><strong>Report.</strong> Export to Excel, Word, CSV and images.</span></li>
        <li><i class="bi bi-shield-lock"></i><span><strong>Your own account.</strong> Your projects follow you to any computer, and nobody else can see them.</span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>

    <div class="tb-landing-foot">© 2026 Sustainable Solutions Tanzania (SST) · TakwimuBridge</div>
  </section>

  <section class="tb-landing-main">
    <div class="card tb-landing-card">
      <div class="card-body">
        <h2 id="tb-land-title">Welcome</h2>
        <div class="alert small py-2 d-none" id="tb-land-notice" role="status"></div>
        <div id="tb-land-auth"></div>
        <div class="tb-landing-or"><span>or</span></div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary w-100" id="tb-land-guest">
          Continue without an account <i class="bi bi-arrow-right ms-1"></i>
        </button>
        <p class="small text-muted text-center mt-2 mb-0">Try the demo project or work in this browser only. You can create an account later.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <nav class="tb-landing-links" aria-label="Help">
      <a href="guide.html"><i class="bi bi-journal-text me-1"></i>User Guide</a>
      <a href="about.html"><i class="bi bi-info-circle me-1"></i>About &amp; Scope</a>
    </nav>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Read the address now: the sync library tidies email-link results out
  // of it once it loads.
  var linkHash = window.location.hash;
  var linkQuery = window.location.search;

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var TB = window.TB;
    var gate = window.TB_GATE;
    if (!gate || !gate.enabled) { window.location.replace("index.html"); return; }

    var title = document.getElementById("tb-land-title");
    var notice = document.getElementById("tb-land-notice");
    function showNotice(kind, text) {
      notice.className = "alert small py-2 alert-" + kind;
      notice.textContent = text;
    }

    var mode = new URLSearchParams(linkQuery).get("mode") === "signup" ? "signup" : "signin";
    TB.ui.mountAuthForm(document.getElementById("tb-land-auth"), "tb-land", {
      mode: mode,
      onMode: function (m, t) { title.textContent = m === "signin" ? "Welcome" : t; },
      done: function () { window.location.replace(gate.next()); }
    });

    // A confirmation or reset link that didn't work comes back here.
    var info = new URLSearchParams(linkHash.replace(/^#/, "") + "&" + linkQuery.replace(/^\?/, ""));
    var code = info.get("error_code"), desc = info.get("error_description");
    if (code || desc) {
      showNotice("warning", code === "otp_expired" || /expired|invalid/i.test(desc || "")
        ? "That email link has expired or has already been used. Sign in below; if your account isn't confirmed yet, you'll be offered a new confirmation email."
        : "That email link didn't work" + (desc ? " (" + desc + ")" : "") + ". Try signing in, or ask for a new link.");
      var keep = new URLSearchParams(linkQuery).get("next");
      history.replaceState(null, "", window.location.pathname + (keep ? "?next=" + encodeURIComponent(keep) : ""));
    }

    document.getElementById("tb-land-guest").addEventListener("click", function () {
      gate.setGuest(true);
      window.location.replace(gate.next());
    });

    var cloud = TB.cloud;
    function onStatus(s) {
      if (s.state === "unavailable" && !(code || desc)) {
        showNotice("warning", "The account service can't be reached right now, so signing in may not work. You can continue without an account meanwhile — your work is saved in this browser.");
      }
    }
    onStatus(cloud.status());
    cloud.on("status", onStatus);
  });
})();
</script>
```
